raw_response: {"diagnosis":"silver_transactions sums raw amount without looking at currency, so the 84 EUR rows are treated as USD. raw_fx_rates has exactly one rate per currency (EUR 1.25 to USD, as_of 2026-01-01, before all transactions), so I convert amounts to USD in silver_transactions and the gold tables follow.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(r.amount * fx.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates fx ON fx.currency = r.currency WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'"}}
